_comment: Task ledger for the interrupted final quality pass. One row per bounded unit of work: task, status, verification. Written so a session that dies mid-pass can be resumed without redoing finished work and without mistaking a killed agent for a completed one. Narrative belongs in docs/CONTENT_COMPLETION_STATE.md; this file stays a checklist.

translationSlices._comment: Each partial locale is 2,733 rows in four slices of 684/684/684/681. status: DONE = merged into content/vocabulary/copy/<locale>.json and validated; GENERATED = rows written to scratchpad, not yet merged; PARTIAL = resumable append in progress; TODO = not started.
